name: Goouin Madoka
source:
Third year student.
She is the heir of a big conglomerate that pretty much controls Japan, and also acts as the board chairwoman of the school.
Beautiful and talented, but also arrogant and sadistic, seems to think the world revolves around herself.
A charismatic leader who is tolerant to those who follow her, while also wanting to be feared by them.
